Experience with Apple iOS device support and MDM enrolment concepts. Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms. Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Teams, Teams Rooms, and collaboration technologies. Basic understanding of networking, structured cabling, patching, and infrastructure support activities. Experience working with remote support tools such as TeamViewer or equivalent. Strong customer service, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Swedish language capability (strong advantage for the Karlskoga, Solna and Höganäs sites). Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining tightly integrated with remote teams. Health, safety and site rules: comply fully with customer site access, safety and security policies at all times. Continual improvement: identify recurring issues, automation and shift-left opportunities; participate in problem reviews and service improvement forums. Reporting: contribute to monthly service reporting - volumes, MTTR, asset accuracy, CSAT and improvement actions.
